title: WowLuvIt
tagline: A decentralized Web 3.0 social media app sharing the ad-revenue with the user-community.
description: Because of revenue sharing, people can use the app to increase their income by increasing their user-engagement. Additionally, user-content belongs to the user. Further, by adding crypto payments more people can be exposed to using crypto as a currency.
how_its_made: We ran into a major problem in trying to use the Biconomy wallet system. Additionally, two of the devs used different systems to develop their respective tasks. And further there were issues in testing out the smart contracts with the frontend as the smart contract was too big for deployment.
